title.value: Lie Point Symmetry and Physics Informed Neural Networks
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: Lie Point Symmetry and Physics Informed Neural Networks

extractions.description: The paper introduces a mechanism for leveraging the symmetries of a given Partial Differential Equation (PDE) to improve Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINN) performance. It proposes a loss function that informs the network about Lie point symmetries, ensuring that infinitesimal generators of the Lie group preserve solutions of the PDE. The results demonstrate that Lie point symmetries of the PDEs are an effective inductive bias for PINNs, leading to a significant increase in sample efficiency.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: While the paper mentions applications in climate science, the core focus is on improving the efficiency of solving PDEs using machine learning, rather than directly addressing sustainability issues.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: learning to solve PDEs, as an alternative to existing numerical solvers, can significantly impact various areas of science, ranging from biology to climate science to cosmology
